name: Battery Technology Lab
description: Operation of the battery testers, measurement of battery capacity, full charge-discharge test, battery charging profiles, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, battery pulse test and HPPC; battery cycling and storage tests, battery data processing and model building, impact of c-rate on battery performance, battery thermal and mechanical stress tests, battery disassembly, inspection of battery electrodes and separator, building battery packs from cells, analyzing commercial BMS, BMS testing.
